component: Competing primary regions: a second board beside the puzzle board
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (training-notes.md N4, N5). Observed: the notes panel showed a full 280px board next to the 328 to 352px solving board, which is 79 to 90 percent of the primary region at 1180 and on a phone. Two equal regions compete, the eye has no single place to start. Phase 2: the duplicate view is secondary: collapsed by default, capped at 15rem (240px) at every width, smaller than the primary region in every layout, created on first open. Generalizes: a preview next to an editor, a mini map next to a map, a second chart. Related approved guidance: P01 hierarchy and P09 simplicity apply in spirit but neither says a duplicate view must be capped relative to the primary region.

classification.rationale: No principle limits a secondary view of the same object. Gap. Suggested: one rule in candidate P23: a second view of the primary object is secondary, closed by default and capped well below it. Owner confirmation needed.
